text: Default eval_weights (hygiene=0.5, growth=0.5, project=0.0) make project-specific improvements completely invisible to composite score
Combining orthogonal improvements (observability + testability + code extraction) delivers compounding returns when eval metrics are correctly configured
Factory's built-in observability dimension does not detect JavaScript console logging; only Python logging patterns are scored
Factory's built-in tests dimension only detects Python pytest; JavaScript unit tests require explicit project eval configuration
Extract pure functions before writing tests to reduce coupling and improve test clarity
Factory finalize gate runs its own precheck and can override CEO KEEP verdicts; use --force flag when gate has structural config issues
